thread:
maria_torres: FYI AcmeHealth sent back the vendor risk form with three items: SOC2 scope confirmation, embeddings retention details, and BYOK timeline. They want answers before renewal cutover next week.

josh_kim: Quick draft replies for the form: SOC2 scope = production-hosted systems only; embeddings retention = default 30 days, configurable per-tenant; deletion = async purge job + audit log; BYOK = supported via cloud KMS for hosted, full HSM/BYOK for Dedicated/Private with longer lead time.

alex_cheng: Legal note : we'll accept our standard DPA language. For BYOK/HSM we need an engineering attestation explaining key custody and access controls, plus logs evidence. Ask if BYOK is required to renew.

ellie_ramirez: Ellie (CS): I'll send the form responses but need exact wording for the embeddings question to copy/paste. Also want the expected timeline for cloud KMS onboarding.

josh_kim: Paste this: "Q: Are embeddings stored and what is retention/deletion procedure? A: Embeddings are stored up to 30 days by default for hosted customers. Customers can request a shorter retention period or immediate deletion. Deletion requests trigger an asynchronous purge job; live storage and KV caches are cleared and an audit log entry is created. Final purge typically completes within 24 hours. For customer-managed encryption, we support cloud KMS integrations (AWS/GCP). Full BYOK with HSM or on-prem keys is available on Dedicated/Private deployments and requires an onboarding window."

ellie_ramirez: Perfect. Also asking EngOps ETA for cloud KMS onboarding so I can include it.

engops_bot: ENGOPS-1601 created, assignee: sophie_liu, requested ETA: 48 hours for cloud KMS onboarding; 3-4 weeks for Dedicated/Private HSM work (dependent on customer procurement).

alex_cheng: Add offering to provide a deletion attestation PDF and access log snapshot for their audit. Also ask the customer which retention option they prefer (30/7/0) and whether BYOK is mandatory.

maria_torres: Sending back to AcmeHealth now with those questions and the attestation offer. Will update thread when they reply.
notes: CS thread coordinating legal + engops answers for vendor risk form; ENGOPS ticket created
